candidates.name: Licensed Early Education and Care Program Tuition
candidates.description:
This data set includes median early education and care tuition rates for Massachusetts. Median rates are calculated by program type, age group, and EEC subsidy region. Tuition rates reported by providers were converted to a daily rate to allow for consistent comparisons and weighted by providers’ licensed capacity. Data are updated monthly.
